title: Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
description: A flaw was found in the Apache Log4j 2 logging framework. The log4j2-core package allows remote code execution via JNDI lookup when attacker-controlled data is logged. This vulnerability is widely exploited in the wild.

title: Remote Code Execution (Log4j2 incomplete fix)
description: The fix to address CVE-2021-44228 in Apache Log4j 2.15.0 was incomplete. A remote attacker with ability to control log messages or log message parameters can execute arbitrary code by crafting malicious input data using a JNDI lookup.

title: Remote Code Execution (Spring4Shell)
description: A Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux application running on JDK 9+ may be vulnerable to remote code execution via data binding. The specific exploit requires the application to run on Tomcat as a WAR deployment. If the application is deployed as a Spring Boot executable jar, i.e. the default, it is not vulnerable to the exploit.

title: Remote Code Execution via String Interpolation (Text4Shell)
description: Apache Commons Text performs variable interpolation, allowing properties to be dynamically evaluated and expanded. The standard format for interpolation is ${prefix:name}, where 'prefix' is used to locate an instance of org.apache.commons.text.lookup.StringLookup that performs the interpolation. Starting with version 1.5 and continuing through 1.9, the set of default Lookup instances included interpolators that could result in arbitrary code execution.

title: Information Disclosure via Temporary Directory
description: Netty is an asynchronous event-driven network application framework for rapid development of maintainable high performance protocol servers & clients. If temporary files are created in a shared directory, an attacker can read them.

title: Remote Code Execution via Key Injection
description: A security flaw was found in jsonwebtoken <=8.5.1. In the verify function, there is an issue where an attacker, who is not able to forge valid tokens, can potentially access other users' data and perform an unauthorized privilege escalation if they have physical access to the code.

title: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS)
description: Axios NPM package before 0.21.2 is vulnerable to Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) via the trim function.

title: Buffer Overflow
description: Pillow through 8.3.1 allows an attacker to cause a denial of service or potentially execute arbitrary code via a crafted file. The vulnerability exists in the TIFF image reader.

title: SQL Injection via QuerySet.annotate(), aggregate(), extra()
description: A SQL injection issue was discovered in Django 2.2 before 2.2.28, 3.2 before 3.2.13, and 4.0 before 4.0.4. QuerySet.annotate(), aggregate(), and extra() methods are subject to SQL injection in column aliases using a crafted dictionary (with dictionary expansion) as the kwargs.

title: Denial of Service via Inefficient Regular Expression
description: Nokogiri is an open source XML and HTML library for Ruby. Nokogiri prior to version 1.13.2 is affected by a regular expression denial of service (ReDoS). There is a vulnerability in the HTML4 parser's handling of `<br` due to the regular expression detecting whether the tag is a valid HTML4 tag.

title: Stack-based Buffer Overflow
description: jackson-databind 2.10.x through 2.12.x before 2.12.6 and 2.13.x before 2.13.1 has a Java StackOverflow exception and denial of service via a large depth of nested objects.

title: Command Injection via template()
description: Lodash versions prior to 4.17.21 are vulnerable to Command Injection via the template function, which can be exploited by an attacker by providing a specially crafted payload.

title: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS)
description: All versions of package path-parse are vulnerable to Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) via splitDeviceRe, splitTailRe, and splitPathRe regular expressions.

title: Type Confusion in X.509 GeneralName
description: There is a type confusion vulnerability relating to X.400 address processing inside an X.509 GeneralName. X.400 addresses were parsed as an ASN1_STRING but the public structure definition for GENERAL_NAME incorrectly specified the type of the x400Address field as ASN1_TYPE.

title: Denial of Service via SPEL Expression
description: In Spring Framework versions 5.3.x prior to 5.3.19, 5.2.x prior to 5.2.21, and older unsupported versions, applications that use Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux can be vulnerable to a denial of service attack through a specially crafted Spring Expression Language (SpEL) expression.
